item.title: What Does Venezuela’s Amnesty Law Propose and What Do Critics Say Is Missing?
item.description: Venezuela’s draft Amnesty Law promises to dismiss political cases, end investigations and lift judicial measures for hundreds of detainees prosecuted since 1999. Yet opposition leaders, legal experts and NGOs argue that the bill’s narrow scope, reliance on the current justice system and lack of broader safeguards leave critical gaps in a country emerging from a sudden political transition La entrada What Does Venezuela’s Amnesty Law Propose and What Do Critics Say Is Missing? se publicó primero
